parts.text: Imperial College London has great funding opportunities for postdocs through the Eric and Wendy Schmidt AI in Science Postdoctoral Fellowships. The deadline is only a week away, but check them out here:
There is a special path to the fellowship for a collaboration with the CNRS, thus

and myself, we are looking for postdoc candidates. We would be able to discuss being your mentors if you apply through this path and are interested in the intersection of Conversation AI, healthcare and design.

The Eric and Wendy Schmidt AI in Science Postdoctoral Fellowship, supported by Schmidt Sciences (Research Fellow Level) is for applicants who have several years post-PhD experience and experience in supervising team members; the experience post-PhD can be in either academic research or industry.

The Eric and Wendy Schmidt AI in Science Postdoctoral Fellowship, supported by Schmidt Sciences (Research Associate Level) is most suitable for those more recently out of their PhD.

The Chapman-Schmidt Fellowship (Research Fellow level) is for applicants who have several years post-PhD experience and experience of supervision of team members; the experience post-PhD can be in either academic research or industry. This is a 2-year role where the principal mentor is in Mathematics.

The Chapman-Schmidt Fellowship (Research Associate level) is most suitable for those more recently out of their PhD. This is a 2-year role where the principal mentor is in Mathematics.

Feel free to contact me via email if you have questions!
